messages:
maria.s: Heads-up — planning to deploy v2.14.0 to staging tomorrow 09:30 PST. Need quick pre-deploy sign-offs and owners for smoke checks + rollback readiness. Checklist below, pls ack and assign roles.

```
[ ] PR merged to main (link)
[ ] Infra migrations applied to staging
[ ] DB backup snapshot taken (prod window)
[ ] Canary rollout plan (10% -> 100%)
[ ] Smoke test script + thresholds
[ ] Rollback procedure documented + tag ready (v2.13-stable)
[ ] On-call and escalation list confirmed
```

maria.s: If you can, add : who triggers, who runs smoke, who watches metrics. I want explicit thumbs-up before we schedule prod deploy.

alex_k: I can run the smoke tests and watch latency/errs. Will prep the smoke command and expected thresholds by EOD.

samuel: I'll own the actual deploy (trigger + rollout). Plan: 10% canary for 15m, then 100% if metrics green. Will be online at 09:15 PST to start.

jin: Infra migrations have been applied to staging; prod migration scripts validated in dry-run. I've scheduled a prod backup at 08:30 PST the day of deploy.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: deploy-job/7890 for 2026-03-18 09:30 PST (staging). Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/7890

maria.s: Excellent. alex_k — can you paste the smoke commands and thresholds here? Also confirm expected p99/p95 latency baselines.

alex_k: smoke commands: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' 
python tests/smoke_run.py --env=staging --suite=quick
```
Thresholds: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms, error_rate < 0.1% over 15m window. If any threshold breached, abort and revert to v2.13-stable.

samuel: A note on rollback trigger: I'll initiate rollback if error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 300ms for 10m. Aggressive but keeps customer impact low.

jin: Prod infra checklist: migrations/2026-03-17-v2_14.sql applied dry-run OK. Snapshot id: snap-20260317-1230. KMS keys validated.

maria.s: Sign-offs? Please react here with :thumbsup: and confirm role. I need explicit text ack (not only emoji) from owners.

alex_k: ACK — will run smoke, monitor latency/errors, post results in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

samuel: ACK — I'll trigger deploy, monitor rollout, and execute rollback if thresholds hit. :thumbsup:

jin: ACK — infra migrations verified, backups scheduled, will stand by for migration step in prod window. :thumbsup:

maria.s: Cool. Final reminders: 1) PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/452 2) Canary config stored at ops/canary/v2_14.yaml 3) Rollback command: `ci rollback --tag v2.13-stable --env=prod`

maria.s: I'll schedule the production slot after we get a final thumbs-up here and confirm on-call coverage. Moving the deploy announcement to #eng-oncall channel once prod time is set.

samuel: I'll also add a short runbook note in the PR describing how to revert DB changes if needed.

maria.s: Thanks everyone — I'll close the loop in the morning. If anything changes ping me directly.

alex_k: Quick question: do we want to run the full eval suite post-canary or just smoke? I vote smoke + a short subset of critical evals (latency/consistency) during canary.

maria.s: Agreed — smoke + critical evals (3 tests) during canary, full runbook after 100% success.

samuel: All set from my side. I'll post a short deploy checklist message 15m before trigger in #eng-oncall.

jin: Standing by.

deploy-bot: Note: If job 7890 is manually promoted to prod, create prod-job/7891 and include runbook link.
